angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,210,518 km at 492.14 pc = 0.03 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 2.0319 +/- 0.0344 mas (same row, RUWE 1.26): 492.14 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.74 +/- 0.04 solar radii from Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of KOI-13 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract): 1,210,518 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.72 +/- 0.1 solar masses from Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of KOI-13 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 7650 +/- 250 K from Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KOI-13 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KOI-13 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kepler-13.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.192, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+46 2629A: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KOI-13 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.2 dex, from Esteves et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KOI-13 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.971, from Calculated Value (/docs/pscp_calc.html)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KOI-13 (pscomppars): age 1.12 Gyr, from Morton et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...822...86M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KOI-13 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 65 km/s, from Barnes et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..197...10B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
